prompt: A company randomly assigns users either to receive a new app notification or to receive no notification, then compares next-day app use. Which statement best identifies the design element or flaw?

options.text: The no-notification group is a control group, providing a baseline for comparison with the new notification treatment.
The no-notification group is blinding, because users know they did not get a notification.

misconception_source.label: Confused control, blinding, placebo, and randomization

sources.note: randomization, control, placebo, and blinding serve different roles in experimental design

options.text: There must be confounding because people use apps for many reasons.

misconception_source.label: Confused confounding with a lurking variable or unrelated association

sources.note: experimental and observational designs require identifying confounding and other design flaws

options.text: This is observational because the company compares existing users.

misconception_source.label: Treated an observational study as an experiment

sources.note: observational studies do not impose treatments; experiments do
